title: Samaritan Village Rejects Jesus
description: As the time drew near for Jesus to be taken up, he resolutely set his face toward Jerusalem and sent messengers ahead of him. They entered a Samaritan village to make preparations for him, but the village did not welcome him because his face was set toward Jerusalem. When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked the Lord if they should command fire to come down from heaven and consume them. But Jesus turned and rebuked them, and they went on to another village.
